title: The Haymakers' Lunch

intro.speaker: hannah
intro.text: The last of the hay is in! Everyone's hot and hungry. Lunch is bread rolls, under the big tree.

intro.speaker: hannah
intro.text: Will you share them out, so every haymaker has the same?

steps.speaker: hannah
steps.prompt: Share the rolls so every plate has the same.

older.prompt: Share seventeen rolls among five plates. Any left over go to the hens!

feedback.all_good: Three rolls each. Now everyone can rest in the shade.

outro.speaker: hannah
outro.text: Hard work, good bread, and friends to share it with. That's a fine summer day.

journal_line: I shared lunch with the haymakers at the farm.
